key: neurips2025/CSPCL_Category Semantic Prior Contrastive Learning for Deformable DETR-Based Prohibited Item Detectors.pdf
path: neurips2025/CSPCL_Category Semantic Prior Contrastive Learning for Deformable DETR-Based Prohibited Item Detectors.pdf
title: CSPCL: Category Semantic Prior Contrastive Learning for Deformable DETR-Based Prohibited Item Detectors
one_line: 基于类别语义先验的对比学习提升X射线违禁品检测
innovations: 类别语义先验对比学习(CSPCL)机制
method_framework: 将分类器权重作为类别原型，通过ITA和IAR损失对齐内容查询与类别特征分布，增强模型对前景特征的敏感性
experiment_framework: 在PIXray、OPIXray、PIDray和CLCXray数据集上测试，与DINO等基线模型对比AP/mAP指标
takeaways: 特征对齐可提升X射线图像中重叠物体的检测性能
梯度截断机制保留类内多样性
自适应排斥强度处理相似类别
weaknesses: 未分析不同类别间的最佳温度系数τ
缺乏对计算开销的详细分析
